com.mindfusion.keyboard

Class RegularKey

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.mindfusion.keyboard.Key
      • com.mindfusion.keyboard.RegularKey

  • public final class RegularKey
extends Key
    Represents regular keyboard keys that send character codes as input.
